meta.status_detail: Round 1 (workspace proposal 3674c0c1) migration. si_reformatting_policy and the three figure_dpi_minimum_* keys were independently verified 2026-09-11 against Elsevier's own elsevier.com/subject/next/guide-for-authors and artwork-FAQ pages. emphasis_style carries a CAVEAT inherited from proposal 3674c0c1, not independently re-verified in that pass: its original citation was Elsevier's general 'Copyediting Specification for Authors v3.0' (a book-authors document), used as the closest available official signal rather than a journal-specific guide -- an explicitly flagged imperfect substitution. The 2026-09-11 pass's own search independently found matching 'discouraged' emphasis guidance on a general journal-facing guide-for-authors page, which corroborates but does not fully resolve that original caveat (a single generic page, not a per-journal check) -- see emphasis_style's own source.note below.
